summary_md: **Autumn Imaginations ([@mexxmillion](https://x.com/mexxmillion/status/2116118141927579772))** presents **Comfy Commander**, an open, agent-friendly control plane that runs ComfyUI workflows from phone or desktop, spreads jobs across local GPUs and rents RunPod/Vast GPUs to grow capacity ([demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BcmLkvfzL3E&feature=youtu.be), [mexxmillion/comfy-commander](https://github.com/mexxmillion/comfy-commander)).
